Title: Maple Syrup Production
Content: New York State is `text(one)` of the leading producers of maple syrup. This process begins with inserting a spout into a maple tree. Sap (sugar water) flows into buckets for collection. The sap is then transferred into pans and heated to reduce the water content in sap to make the more concentrated maple syrup.
